recognize_zh: 范可尼貧血（Fanconi anemia）男孩大腿上有數個大型、邊界清楚的環狀紫紅色斑塊，部分中央潰瘍結痂；皮膚切片可見真皮內瀰漫浸潤的單核芽細胞，細胞化學染色呈紅色陽性顆粒，符合骨髓外的骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma，皮膚白血病）。
features: Clinical: multiple large annular violaceous-to-erythematous plaques on the thigh, some with central ulceration and eschar
Skin biopsy: diffuse dermal infiltrate of discohesive mononuclear cells splaying collagen bundles
Infiltrating cells are medium to large with round to indented nuclei
Enzyme cytochemistry on tissue: many infiltrating cells show red granular cytoplasmic positivity (POX/NACE per source)
Lower panel: positive cells infiltrate between collagen/muscle fibers in a single-file pattern
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple large, well-demarcated annular violaceous plaques on the lateral thigh, several with central ulceration and eschar. The skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of discohesive medium-to-large mononuclear cells dissecting between collagen bundles and adnexal/muscle fibers. Enzyme cytochemical stains performed on tissue show granular red cytoplasmic positivity in many of the infiltrating cells, supporting myeloid (myelomonocytic) lineage; individual stains cannot be separated with certainty from the image alone. In a patient with Fanconi anemia and a non-leukemic, hypocellular marrow, findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis) with myelomonocytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous B- or T-cell lymphoma / lymphoblastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoid infiltrates are negative for myeloperoxidase and chloroacetate esterase and express CD20/CD3 or TdT rather than MPO, CD33, CD68, and lysozyme.
BPDCN also forms violaceous skin plaques but is MPO/NACE negative and expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4.

ddx.dx: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis or infectious (ecthyma) lesions in cytopenic host
ddx.vs: Vasculitis and infection show neutrophil-rich vessel-centered inflammation or organisms, not a monotonous sheet of blasts.
Sweet syndrome shows a dermal infiltrate of mature neutrophils with papillary dermal edema rather than immature myelomonocytic blasts.

stain: Clinical photo; cytochemistry: POX and NACE
